content.title: Cardi B and Offset's Relationship Timeline
content.text: Cardi B and Offset's relationship has been nothing short of dramatic—the rapper even said it herself. From their publicized proposal and high-profile pregnancy to their cheating scandal and eventual split, here is everything you need to know about Cardi B and Offset's relationship. Cardi B and Offset met in 2016, but their romantic relationship began in early 2017. They secretly tied the knot on September 20, 2017, and Offset proposed to the rapper onstage a month later. News of their wedding didn't break until June 2018. On July 10, 2018, the couple welcomed their first child together, a daughter named Kulture Kiari Cephus. Cardi B filed for divorce from her rapper husband in September 2020, but they called it off two months later. In December 2023, Cardi B confirmed her split from her former husband. 2016: First Meeting While not much is known about exactly how Cardi B and Offset first met, the female rapper claimed they first met at an "industry event" in 2016. "He was very consistent," Cardi said of Offset's intentions that night. "He really wanted to talk to me.” January 20, 2017: Their First Track With both of their musical careers on the rise, Cardi and Offset released track "Lick" together early in 2017. As far as the public was concerned, the pair wasn't more than friends and collaborators. February 5, 2017: First Date at the Super Bowl In what is probably one of the most iconic first dates, Cardi B and Offset tested out a romantic relationship at the 2017 Super Bowl. Later, Offset revealed to Rolling Stone that he asked his publicist to coordinate a group dinner with Cardi B and the Houston-based Super Bowl was, in fact, their first official date. "That’s a power move," he recalled of his efforts. June 22, 2017: He's "The Boy" During her cover interview for the July 2017 issue of Fader, Cardi refused to confirm or deny her relationship with Offset. However, she did give some hints to fans about her relationship status when she referred to him as "the boy." Cardi added, "It’s been a blessing, me meeting him and meeting his friends. I see how hard they work. And that motivated me to work even harder." August 27, 2017: Cardi's Ready For a Ring Getty Images Cardi B has always spoken her mind, so when she blatantly dropped an engagement hint to Offset at the MTV Video Music Awards pre-show in 2017 the gesture was no surprise. "I'm a woman. Every woman, I think, wants to get married and wants to have children," she told Charlamagne Tha God. "It's never too early to get married now. You know, if you want to propose to me, you can." At this time though, she still had yet to confirm her romance with the Migos rapper. September 20, 2017: Secret Wedding Unbeknownst to the public, Cardi B and Offset got married in Atlanta, Georgia on September 20, 2017. They said "I do" in their apartment and Cardi's cousin was their only witness. The marriage would remain a secret for nine months until TMZ discovered a marriage certificate in June 2018! October 21, 2017: Cardi Claims She's Single In a now-deleted Instagram post, Cardi B called herself single. A few hours later she took down the post and called the statement "extreme." The following day, she tweeted, "Naaa but on a serious note I really loveeeee my man he was gifted to me from Jesus." October 27, 2017: $500,000 Proposal On October 27, 2017, Offset proposed to Cardi B onstage at a concert in Philadelphia (despite marrying each other a month earlier). He presented the "Bodak Yellow" singer with a whopping 20-carat diamond ring that reportedly cost a half a million dollars. January 2018: Cheating Rumors Getty Images Despite their public engagement, the celebrity couple was rocked by cheating rumors at the end of 2017 and into the new year. There were rumors that Offset cheated on Cardi and even made a sex tape with someone else. The female rapper turned to social media to defend her relationship with Offset and even told fans "You pull that s--- again, you gonna lose your wife" mid-performance. January 14, 2018: Offset Gets Inked On Jan. 18, Offset showed off some new ink: Cardi B's name tattooed on his neck. April 7, 2018: Cardi Confirms Her Pregnancy After months of pregnancy rumors (which the rapper repeatedly denied), the suspicions were confirmed on April 7, 2018. Cardi B revealed her growing baby bump during an appearance on Saturday Night Live. The next morning Offset told fans on Twitter, "Cardi and I look forward to our next chapter together." June 25, 2018: Secret Marriage Revealed On June 25, 2018, TMZ revealed the music power couple had been married for months—nine to be exact! Cardi also confirmed the news on Twitter, saying, "There are so many moments that I share with the world and there are moments that I want to keep for myself! Getting married was one of those moments! Our relationship was so new breaking up and making up and we had a lot of growing to do but we was so in love we didn't want to lose each other." July 10, 2018: Kulture Kiari Cephus Is Born Cardi B and Offset welcomed their first child together on July 10, 2018. They named their newborn daughter Kulture Kiari Cephus. The announcement was marked by an extravagant nude photo of the pregnant singer. September 20, 2018: First Anniversary In honor of the couple's first anniversary, Cardi shared a never-before-seen photo from the wedding day, which featured the ceremony exactly as she described a few months earlier. Offset and Cardi B even exchanged vows in coordinating tracksuits! December 4, 2018: The First Break-Up "We've got a lot of love for each other, but things just haven't been working out between us for a long time. And it's nobody's fault," she said. "It's just, like, I guess we grew out of love. But we're not together anymore," Cardi B said on Instagram announcing her break-up with Offset. December 9, 2018: Offset Misses His Wife Just four days after Cardi B shared their break-up news, Offset tweeted that he missed his wife. December 15, 2018: A Public Apology After Cardi denounced that her relationship with Offset was fake, the male rapper turned to Instagram to apologize for his behavior. “I wanna apologize to you, Cardi,” he said in a video. “I know I embarrassed you. I was partaking in activity I shouldn’t have been taking in.” December 16, 2018: "Take Me Back Cardi" Getty Images Who could forget when Offset interrupted Cardi B's set at the Rolling Loud music festival to win her back? The rapper hopped onstage with a large sign that read "Take me back Cardi." Cardi seemed to be annoyed but later rumors circulated that the "I Like It" singer was aware of the stunt. December 22, 2018: Holiday Vacation Offset's grand gesture seemingly worked as the pair were seen vacationing in Puerto Rico around the holidays. February 10, 2019: Back Together Again Getty Images TMZ reported the couple had reconciled on January 31, 2019, and on February 10, Cardi B and Offset walked the Grammys red carpet together. They French kissed on the red carpet and sat next to each other during the show. Offset even joined her onstage when she accepted the award for Best Rap Album. July 21, 2019: Cardi Gets Inked After Offset debuted his Cardi B tattoo a year and a half earlier, Cardi finally returned the favor with ink of her own: "Offset" written on her thigh. December 2019: Overcoming Scandal Getty Images In her cover interview with Vogue, Cardi opened up about Offset's cheating scandal the year prior, saying, "I believe in forgiveness. I prayed on it. Me and my husband, we prayed on it. We had priests come to us. And we just came to an understanding like bro, it's really us against the world." September 15, 2020: Cardi Files For Divorce Five days before celebrating their third wedding anniversary, Cardi B filed for divorce from Offset. According to the documents obtained by TMZ, she requested primary physical custody of daughter Kulture. And per E! News, the divorce files claimed the marriage to be "irrevocably broken" and the singer requested child support. October 10, 2020: Birthday Kisses Less than a month after filing for divorce, Offset was seen at Cardi B's 28th birthday celebration in Las Vegas. A series of Instagram videos showed the couple dancing with each other and sharing a few kisses. November 2, 2020: Cardi Calls Off Divorce Almost two months after filing for divorce—and one month after a very public display of affection—Cardi filed papers in Georgia to dismiss the previous motion, per TMZ. However, the singer filed the dismissal "without prejudice," meaning she could refile for divorce from Offset in the future. June 27, 2021: A Second Pregnancy While performing with Offset and Migos at the 2021 BET Awards, Cardi B announced that she's expecting again. Her outfit, a Dolce & Gabbana bodysuit with a sheer panel in the abdomen, also exposed her baby bump. September 4, 2021: Their Son's Arrival The couple welcomed their second child together, son Wave Set Cephus (although they didn't reveal his name until April 2022), on September 4, 2023. To announce the exciting news, Cardi B posted a photo of herself holding her newborn baby boy while sitting in the hospital bed with Offset. "9/4/21🦕💙🧸," she captioned the picture. November 19, 2021: Commendable Parenting Skills While appearing on Good Morning America, Cardi B praised Offset's parenting skills. "He is definitely hands-on," the rapper said before joking that he can sometimes be "too hands-on." "I be like, 'Listen, I got it. I know what I'm doing, too,'" she quipped. "This ain't my first rodeo anymore." June 26, 2023: Cheating Allegations Offset posted a since-deleted Instagram Story, claiming that Cardi B cheated on him. On a Twitter Space conversation, Cardi B responded to the post, refuting the allegations. The following month, Offset denied his initial claims, saying they were arguing and he was "really lit." December 11, 2023: Their Official Split During an Instagram Live, Cardi B confirmed that she and Offset have split. "I've been single for a minute now," she said. "But I have been afraid—not afraid, I just don't know how to tell the world. But I feel like today has been a sign." She also noted that she had unfollowed Offset on Instagram, which might have hinted at the status of their relationship. "I don't know if you guys have been getting clues from me, from my Lives, or from my Stories, when I put some certain music, or find my unfollowings," she added.
